review.posthog_relevance: Adds drag-and-drop interaction and fullscreen state management to the lineage graph visualization, potentially improving user configuration and inspection capabilities.
review.reason: The change introduces substantive UI behavior: P1.F9.H5 adds props and handlers for drag-and-drop and node positioning, while P1.F11.H6 adds state and actions to support this. P1.F1.H1, P1.F2.H1, and P1.F3.H1 are minor maintenance or setup changes supporting this. This represents a bounded capability improvement rather than a systemic risk reduction or narrow maintenance-only task.
review.uncertainty: The exact benefit depends on whether the drag-and-drop and positioning features are actively used and provide value to PostHog users, which cannot be verified from the code alone. No adoption or incident avoidance is established.
